title: From Noisy Retrieval to Decision Evidence: Silver Evidence Demonstrations for In-Context Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.32128v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: RAG and retrieval-augmented few-shot ICL can struggle when decision-relevant evidence is buried in long, noisy context. Retrieved passages and demonstrations may contain redundant or distracting information. Although expert-labeled development examples may identify the text supporting each decision, these annotations are typically used only as answer-side rationales rather than as supervision for filtering noisy retrieval. We propose silver-evidence demonstrations, which replace raw retrieved passages in ICL examples with generated, target-conditioned evidence summaries. For each labeled development example, an LLM generates silver evidence without access to the expert label or gold evidence; this evidence is then paired with the expert label and gold evidence where available. At test time, a single structured call generates silver evidence from retrieved passages and then predicts the final label and decision evidence. Across EI 2.0, Sc

translated_title: 从噪声检索到决策证据：面向上下文学习的银证据示例
translated_abstract: 当与决策相关的证据被埋没在冗长且充满噪声的上下文中时，RAG和检索增强的少样本ICL（上下文学习）可能会表现不佳。检索到的段落和示例可能包含冗余或干扰性信息。尽管专家标注的开发样例可以识别支持每项决策的文本，但这些标注通常仅被用作答案侧的推理依据，而非用于过滤噪声检索的监督信号。我们提出银证据示例，用生成的、以目标为条件的证据摘要替换ICL示例中的原始检索段落。对于每个有标注的开发样例，LLM在不接触专家标签或金标准证据的情况下生成银证据；随后这些证据与专家标签以及可用的金标准证据配对。在测试时，通过单次结构化调用从检索段落中生成银证据，然后预测最终标签和决策证据。在EI 2.0、Sc（摘要在此处被截断）等数据集上……
tldr: 提出“银证据示例”方法，用LLM生成的、以目标为条件的证据摘要替代ICL示例中的原始噪声检索段落，从而将噪声检索转化为可靠的决策证据，提升RAG和少样本上下文学习在长噪声文本中的决策能力。
en_tdlr: Proposes silver-evidence demonstrations, which replace noisy raw retrieved passages in ICL examples with LLM-generated target-conditioned evidence summaries, turning noisy retrieval into reliable decision evidence for RAG and few-shot in-context learning.
